Name: Harvey Caring Dialogue
Author: JFKLARP
Description:
[b][size=4]
Description[/size][/b]
The Harvey Expansion Mod is a Content Patcher dialogue and event overhaul designed to enrich and expand your relationship with Pelican Town's resident doctor. It adds dozens of new, lore-friendly dialogue lines for daily routines, weather occurrences, festivals, and post-marriage life, giving Harvey even more warmth, depth, and personality throughout your farming journey.


[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
Download and install SMAPI (v4.0.0 or higher) and Content Patcher.
Download the latest version of the Harvey Expansion Mod from the Files tab.
Extract the downloaded .zip file.
Drag and drop the [CP] Harvey Expansion Mod folder directly into your Stardew Valley Mods folder:


[b][size=4]Windows (Steam): [/size][/b]
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
GOG (Windows):
C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\Mods
Mac:
~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Contents/MacOS/Mods
Steam Deck / Linux:
~/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods

Launch the game using SMAPI and enjoy!


[b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]
Expanded Daily Dialogue: New conversations tailored to different days of the week, heart levels, and seasons.
1.6 & Weather Reactivity: Special dialogue reactions for unique events like Green Rain days, island trips, and storm weather.
Post-Marriage Depth: Extended pillow talk, clinic banter, and domestic dialogue after marrying Harvey.
Lore-Friendly & Lightweight: Written carefully to stay true to Harvey’s original character while seamlessly fitting into base Stardew Valley.
[b][size=4]

Requirements[/size][/b]
To run this mod smoothly, make sure you have installed the following prerequisite tools:
SMAPI - Stardew Modding API (Mod loader)
Content Patcher (Required to load custom dialogue without overwriting game files)

No additional framework mods or XNB file edits are required!
